title: Aria Buds left earbud disconnects (firmware 3.2.1)
symptoms: After updating Aria Buds to firmware 3.2.1, the left earbud drops out every few minutes while the right one keeps playing. Calls may switch to the right bud only. Re-pairing helps for a short time.
root_cause: A bug in firmware 3.2.1 affects the hand-over of the audio link between the two earbuds.
resolution: Update to firmware 3.2.4 in the QuillCloud app > Devices > Aria Buds > Firmware, with both buds in the open case. Then reset the earbuds (hold the case button 15 seconds until amber flashes three times) and pair again. A replacement is not needed.

title: Nimbus 14 battery drains in sleep (BIOS 1.08)
symptoms: Nimbus 14 laptops on BIOS 1.08 lose 20-40% battery overnight with the lid closed, and may feel warm in a bag. Battery life while in use is normal.
root_cause: BIOS 1.08 prevents the laptop from entering its deepest sleep state.
resolution: Update the BIOS to version 1.10 with Quillfen Update Utility > BIOS, with the charger connected. Until then, use Hibernate instead of Sleep. Battery health is not affected; no warranty claim is needed.

title: Hearth Hub offline on WPA3-only networks
symptoms: The Hearth Hub goes offline (pulsing orange light) after the router's security setting changed to WPA3-only, often after an automatic router update or a new router from the internet provider. Setting the hub up again fails at the Wi-Fi step.
root_cause: Hearth Hub firmware before 5.1 supports WPA2 and WPA2/WPA3 mixed mode, but not WPA3-only.
resolution: In the router settings, set Wi-Fi security to "WPA2/WPA3 mixed" (sometimes called "WPA3 transition mode"). The hub then reconnects and updates itself to firmware 5.1, after which WPA3-only also works.

title: Lumen Cam image flickers after firmware 2.4 (UK/EU)
symptoms: In the UK and EU, after the camera updated to firmware 2.4, the indoor video shows rolling dark bands or flicker under lamps, especially in the evening. Outdoor daylight video looks normal.
root_cause: Firmware 2.4 reset the Anti-flicker setting to 60 Hz on all cameras. UK and EU mains power is 50 Hz.
resolution: In the QuillCloud app > Lumen Cam > Video, set Anti-flicker to 50 Hz. The setting is kept after future updates.

title: Duplicate pending charges after retrying payment
symptoms: Customers see two or three identical pending charges for one order on their card or banking app, usually after the first checkout attempt showed an error and they tried again. Only one order appears in their account.
root_cause: Each checkout attempt places a temporary authorisation. Failed attempts are not charged, but the bank shows the hold until it expires.
resolution: Only one charge is taken. The extra pending authorisations disappear automatically within 3-7 business days, depending on the bank. No action is needed; we cannot release holds earlier. If an extra amount is still shown as a completed (not pending) charge after 7 business days, escalate to the billing team with the order number.

title: Promo code shows 'invalid' for Plus members
symptoms: Quillfen Plus members entering a valid, unexpired promo code see the error "This code is not valid" at checkout, mostly on orders of Quillfen-brand products.
root_cause: Promo codes do not combine with the 5% Plus member price. Checkout should show "Better discount applied" when the member price is larger, but since 1 October 2026 it shows the wrong "not valid" message instead.
resolution: Explain that the larger discount is already applied: the member price is in the order total. If the promo code would have given a bigger discount than the member price, the customer can place the order and support will refund the difference on request.

title: Invoice PDF opens blank in Safari
symptoms: Customers using Safari on Mac, iPhone or iPad get a blank white page or an empty PDF when they click Invoice in Account > Orders.
root_cause: The invoice viewer is not compatible with Safari's built-in PDF preview.
resolution: Use "Email invoice" on the order page to receive the PDF by email, or open the order page in another browser such as Chrome, Firefox or Edge. The invoice itself is correct.

title: Password reset emails delayed for Outlook and Hotmail
symptoms: Customers with outlook.com, hotmail.com or live.com email addresses do not receive the password reset email, or it arrives 30-90 minutes late, by which time the link has expired.
root_cause: The email provider is temporarily slowing delivery of messages from noreply@quillfen.example.
resolution: Request one reset link only, then wait up to 90 minutes without requesting another (each new request cancels the earlier link). Check the Junk folder and add noreply@quillfen.example to safe senders. If the link expires, request a new one and use it as soon as it arrives. Alternatively, sign in with the QuillCloud app if still signed in and change the password under Account > Security.

title: QuillCloud app 4.0 keeps signing users out
symptoms: After updating the QuillCloud app to version 4.0, users are signed out every few minutes or each time they open the app, and see "Session expired". The website works normally. Devices keep working.
root_cause: A bug in app version 4.0 when refreshing the sign-in session.
resolution: Update the app to version 4.0.2 or later. On Android, clear the app cache after updating; on iPhone, delete and reinstall the app. Then sign in again. The password does not need to be reset.

title: Two-step SMS codes not arriving on some UK networks
symptoms: UK customers with two-step verification by SMS do not receive the code, or it arrives after it has expired. This affects some UK mobile networks since mid-October 2026.
root_cause: A delivery problem between our SMS provider and some UK mobile networks.
resolution: Sign in with a backup code, or choose "Send code by email instead" on the verification screen. After signing in, we recommend switching two-step verification to an authenticator app in Account > Security.

title: Canadian orders stuck at 'Label created'
symptoms: Orders to Canada shipped with NorthPost Express show "Label created" in tracking for 5 days or more, with no further updates. The order page says "Shipped".
root_cause: NorthPost Express is not scanning parcels at pick-up during a backlog at its border hub. Parcels are moving even though tracking does not update.
resolution: Most parcels show a scan when they reach the Canadian sorting centre and arrive within 10 business days of shipping. Ask the customer to wait until 15 business days after shipping (the Canadian lost-parcel limit) before we open a lost-parcel investigation. Do not send a replacement earlier.

title: EU customers charged customs fees on parcels from the UK warehouse
symptoms: EU customers who ordered Hearth or Lumen products since 1 October 2026 are asked by the carrier to pay import VAT or a customs clearance fee before delivery. The parcel comes from the UK.
root_cause: Some parcels from the temporary UK warehouse were sent without the "duty paid" label.
resolution: Customers should pay the fee to receive the parcel, keep the carrier's receipt, and submit a customs refund claim in Account > Orders > Get help > Customs fee within 60 days of delivery. The full amount is refunded to the original payment method within 5 business days of approval. Customers may also refuse the parcel; it is then returned and the order is refunded in full.

title: Address autocomplete drops apartment or unit number
symptoms: When customers pick an address from the autocomplete suggestions at checkout, the apartment, unit or flat number they typed is removed. The order confirmation shows the street address without it.
root_cause: A bug in the address suggestion tool.
resolution: Within 1 hour of ordering, the customer can add the unit number in Account > Orders > Edit order. After 1 hour, support adds the unit number for the carrier as a delivery note if the order has not shipped. If it has shipped, US customers can add it through the carrier redirect; elsewhere contact the carrier with the tracking number.

title: Plus free shipping not applied after renewal
symptoms: Quillfen Plus members whose membership renewed in the last 48 hours are charged standard shipping at checkout, even though the membership page shows them as active.
root_cause: After a renewal, the checkout keeps an old membership status for up to 48 hours.
resolution: Sign out and sign in again before checking out; this refreshes the membership status. If shipping was already charged, support refunds the shipping charge to the original payment method on request; no need to cancel the order.

title: Nimbus 14 external monitor black after graphics driver 31.0.15
symptoms: After the graphics driver updated to 31.0.15, an external monitor connected to the Nimbus 14's left USB-C port stays black or shows "No signal". The laptop detects the monitor in Display settings. The built-in screen works.
root_cause: Driver 31.0.15 has a bug with DisplayPort Alt Mode on the Nimbus 14.
resolution: Install graphics driver 31.0.17 from Quillfen Update Utility > Drivers and restart. Keep using the left USB-C port; the right port never supports video.

title: Split-payment refunds issued fully as store credit
symptoms: Customers who paid with a gift card plus a card or PayPal find that their whole refund was added as store credit, instead of the card or PayPal share going back to the original method.
root_cause: A refund system error affecting returns of split-payment orders processed since 20 September 2026.
resolution: Support can convert the card or PayPal share of the store credit back to the original payment method on request, as long as the store credit has not been spent. It then arrives in 5-10 business days for cards or 3-5 for PayPal. The gift card share stays as gift card balance.

title: Aria Max ANC button stops working after firmware 2.0
symptoms: After the update to firmware 2.0, pressing the ANC button on Aria Max does nothing. Noise cancelling can still be changed in the QuillCloud app. Other buttons work.
root_cause: Firmware 2.0 does not always migrate the old button settings correctly.
resolution: Factory reset the headphones: with them on, hold the power and ANC buttons together for 15 seconds until the light flashes red and white, then pair again. The button works normally afterwards. No repair is needed.

title: Hearth Hub schedules one hour off after clock change
symptoms: After the daylight saving time change, Hearth Hub schedules and automations run one hour early or late, for example lights turning on at 6:00 instead of 7:00. The time in the app is correct.
root_cause: Hubs on firmware 5.0.2 or earlier with a manually selected time zone do not apply the clock change.
resolution: In the QuillCloud app > Devices > Hearth Hub > Time zone, turn on "Set automatically", or select the time zone again. Schedules then run at the right time. Firmware 5.0.3 fixes this permanently.

title: Gift card balance shows 0 in the app Wallet
symptoms: Gift cards added to an account show a balance of 0.00 in the QuillCloud app Wallet, although they have not been used.
root_cause: A display error in the app Wallet. The real balance is unchanged and can be used at checkout.
resolution: Check the balance on the website in Account > Wallet or at quillfen.example/giftcard. The gift card can be used normally at checkout on the website or in the app.

title: Order confirmation emails delayed during the Autumn Sale
symptoms: During the Autumn Sale, customers do not receive an order confirmation email, or it arrives several hours late. Some place the same order a second time because they think it failed.
root_cause: A very high volume of emails during the sale.
resolution: If the order appears in Account > Orders, or the customer received a confirmation screen with an order number, the order is placed and does not need to be repeated. Duplicate orders can be cancelled free of charge until they ship.
